I answered from domain knowledge, not from a causal analysis of the data. I only looked at the correlation matrix, which shows the two variables are related but not which way the effect runs.

Physically, more cloud water makes clouds thicker and more emissive. That increases the downward longwave radiation reaching the surface. Longwave flux at the surface has no comparably direct, fast effect on cloud water. So cloud water driving longwave (B) is the more likely direction.

ANSWER: B
